description:
Build a curated test corpus exercising RFC 5280 §4.2.1.6 rfc822Name + RFC 8398 SmtpUTF8Mailbox binding through `verify_smime_signer` and `verify_smime_recipient`.

**Created 2026-05-12** as part of PKIX-fmtv.17's rescope decision (Mark, attended session). Sibling of PKIX-fmtv.22 (TLS hostname corpus). Same rationale: PKITS leaves lack SAN; wrapper-level mailbox-binding tests require a curated corpus.

## Coverage

**RFC 5280 §4.2.1.6 rfc822Name (ASCII)**
- positive: SAN `user@example.com`, mailbox `user@example.com`
- negative: SAN `user@example.com`, mailbox `other@example.com`
- negative: SAN with malformed local-part (no @)

**RFC 5321 case sensitivity**
- positive: SAN `user@EXAMPLE.com`, mailbox `user@example.com` (domain part case-insensitive)
- negative: SAN `User@example.com`, mailbox `user@example.com` (local-part case-sensitive per RFC 5321)
- decision-gate inside the corpus: do we enforce strict RFC 5321 local-part case sensitivity, or follow real-world tolerant matching? Default: strict RFC 5321; document the choice; provide tolerant-match fixture cases as "expected reject under strict, expected accept under tolerant" for future profile work.

**RFC 8398 SmtpUTF8Mailbox**
- positive: SmtpUTF8Mailbox otherName SAN with UTF-8 local-part, mailbox matches
- positive: mixed rfc822Name + SmtpUTF8Mailbox SANs on same leaf (RFC 8398 §3)
- negative: SmtpUTF8Mailbox with malformed UTF-8

**Multi-mailbox SANs**
- positive: leaf has 3 rfc822Name SANs; binding any one of them succeeds
- negative: none of the SANs match the supplied mailbox

**Edge cases**
- negative: quoted local-part `"user with space"@example.com` — RFC 5321 syntactically valid, may or may not be supported by pkix-identity (defer to verify_mailbox behavior)
- negative: empty mailbox (must be a parse error at MailboxName::parse before reaching the wrapper)
- negative: leaf with no rfc822Name and no SmtpUTF8Mailbox SAN

## Source

Hand-curated from RFC 8398 §4 canonical examples + RFC 5280 §4.2.1.6 + RFC 5321 §4.1.2 mailbox syntax. x509-limbo's S/MIME coverage is thinner than its WebPKI coverage; expect to write most cases by hand.

## Fixtures

Same pyca/cryptography tooling pattern as PKIX-fmtv.22. Manifest format identical.

## Tests

Parameterized for both `verify_smime_signer` and `verify_smime_recipient`. EKU semantics differ: signer requires id-kp-emailProtection (assumed via BasicSmimeProfile); recipient may also require it. Confirm with shipped wrapper implementation; corpus is wrapper-agnostic.

## Acceptance

Pass-rate baseline in pkix-chain/tests/mailbox_corpus_baseline.md.

## Out of scope

- Differential testing against OpenSSL — that's PKIX-fmtv.18 consuming this corpus.
- pyca differential — pyca has no S/MIME verifier; .19 documents this scope gap.
- Code-signing / timestamping wrappers — no identity-string target; covered by targeted unit tests, not a curated corpus.
title: Curated RFC 8398 mailbox corpus + verify_smime_signer/recipient tests
